items.summaryEn:
"I think we had a chance to score points for sure, but you have to take it on the chin – you can only control what you can control. Now, we move on to Brazil." 🗣️ AK
Finishing off our time in Mexico City 🇲🇽
#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP

“我认为我们肯定有机会得分，但你要接受现实——你只能控制你能控制的事情。现在，我们继续前进到巴西。” 🗣️ AK
结束我们在墨西哥城的时光 🇲🇽
#哈斯F1 #F1 #墨西哥大奖赛
detailEn:
"I think we had a chance to score points for sure, but you have to take it on the chin – you can only control what you can control. Now, we move on to Brazil." 🗣️ AK

#HaasF1 #F1 #MexicoGP
